tiers.name: Standard 1F1B (Stage 0 Holds 8 Microbatches = 32 GB, Stage 7 Holds 1 = 4 GB)
tiers.note: Severe 8:1 memory imbalance across stages (Stage 0 hits 32.0 GB while Stage 7 uses 4.0 GB) plus an 18.0% pipeline bubble!

tiers.name: Interleaved 1F1B (VPP = 4 Virtual Stages, 4x P2P Volume & +25% Stage-0 Memory)
tiers.note: Cuts bubble by 4x to 5.2%, but multiplies cross-stage P2P traffic by 4.0x and raises Stage-0 peak memory to 39.0 GB -> Stage 0 OOM!

tiers.name: V-Shape Folded 1F1B (2 Chunks/Stage Co-Locating Chunk s and 2P-1-s)
tiers.note: Folds the pipeline into a V-shape so every stage holds exactly 9 half-chunks (18.0 GB uniform across all 8 GPUs) and Emb/LM-Head co-locate on Stage 0!

tiers.name: ZB-V / DualPipe Bidirectional V-Schedule + Split Backward (B=dX, W=dW)
tiers.note: Balances activation memory uniformly at 16.0 GB across all 8 stages (-59% vs VPP=4), co-locates Emb & LM Head on Stage 0, and cuts bubble to 1.8%!
